description: This file is a JavaScript module that provides a browser-compatible implementation of Node.js's 'buffer' module. It defines classes, methods, and properties related to binary data manipulation, including buffer creation, reading, writing, copying, and encoding conversions. It also manages compatibility support for typed arrays across different browsers.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A subclass of Uint8Array with additional methods for handling binary data, including encoding/decoding, comparison, and manipulation.

classes.name: SlowBuffer
classes.description: A constructor for creating non-zero-filled Buffer instances.

methods.name: Buffer
methods.description: Main constructor function that creates Buffer instances from various input types.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a new Buffer from strings, arrays, or ArrayBuffer views.

methods.name: alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new Buffer of a specified size, optionally filled with a value.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a string to the buffer using specified encoding.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Returns a new Buffer that references a subset of the original buffer's data.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Decodes buffer data into a string with specified encoding.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data from this buffer to another buffer.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares this buffer with another for equality.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Returns a string representation for debugging.
